# Rikka

> Rikka is a Discord card collection bot focused on collecting characters from anime and games.

## Languages

The Rikka website is available in:

- Portuguese (Brazil): https://rikka-website.vercel.app/
- English: https://rikka-website.vercel.app/en

## Portuguese Pages

- Home: https://rikka-website.vercel.app/
- How it works: https://rikka-website.vercel.app/como-funciona
- Collection: https://rikka-website.vercel.app/colecao
- Features: https://rikka-website.vercel.app/recursos
- About: https://rikka-website.vercel.app/sobre

## English Pages

- Home: https://rikka-website.vercel.app/en
- How it works: https://rikka-website.vercel.app/en/how-it-works
- Collection: https://rikka-website.vercel.app/en/collection
- Features: https://rikka-website.vercel.app/en/features
- About: https://rikka-website.vercel.app/en/about

## Core Experience

Cards appear through drops, users claim one through a grab, and claimed cards become part of their collection. Wishlists, trades, items, and currency support that collection experience.
